newsitem.title: USA: Employee Solutions named in holder suit.
newsitem.headline: Employee Solutions named in holder suit.

text.p: Employee Solutions Inc and certain officials of the company were named in a complaint seeking class action status, lawyers representing plaintiffs in the case said Tuesday.

The complaint filed in a federal court in Arizona accuses the company, its chief executive officer and chief financial officer of allegedly causing Employee Solutions to inflate its reported earnings.
Employee Solutions is a Phoenix, Ariz.,-based provider of worker leasing and worker compensation services.

The defendants allegedly charged and collected federal and state unemployment taxes from its customers amounts in excess of lawful requirements and then reported the amounts collected as earnings. They also allegedly failed to set up adequate reserves for potential workers' compensation insurance claims.

The law firms of Pomerantz Haudek Block & Grossman and Dalton Gotto Samson & Kilgard PLC said the lawsuit was filed on behalf of buyers of the company's common shares between March 24, 1995 and March 17, 1997.
Several similar lawsuits have been previously filed against the company, which has said that the complaints have no merit and that it would defend itself vigorously.
